Green Lantern Corps

Tomar-Re

A Xudarian veteran of Sector 2813.

Tomar-Re is a Xudarian Green Lantern and an early guide to the Corps beyond Earth. His career connects Hal Jordan’s first space adventures with the wider DC universe.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Green Lantern Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern #6 (1961)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

A scientist from Xudar, Tomar-Re serves Sector 2813 and becomes a trusted colleague of Earth’s Lanterns. Superman #257 gives him a tragic connection to Krypton: he attempts a rescue but cannot prevent its destruction. His son Tomar-Tu later follows him into the Corps. The family connection does not make the two interchangeable characters.
